x: Mike Newton and Tony Hardy both ran very solid legs but unfortunately we had no sixth runner to make up the team. Mike bravely went round again and the team had to settle for an ''unofficial'' 12th place.
Tony Stone limped out of the race with a pulled a hamstring at the end of the first lap which left Tony Hardy to lead in a scoring three made up by John Wasbrough and Mike Newton.
At M50 the Belgrave trio of Tony Stone, John Wasbrough and Tony Hardy, racing again after a long time out through injury, all packed well and finished within 15 seconds of each other.
